name: Flash
description: Clicking sets off a short snap of light at the pointer. A soft round bloom lights up with thin bright spikes radiating from it, the way a lens flare does, and it is gone again in a fifth of a second. Each button has its own colour. Nothing is drawn while the pointer is only moving.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Bloom size
parameters.description: Radius of the round bloom at the middle (px). It cannot grow past the spike length, which is the edge of the drawn area

parameters.name: Spikes
parameters.description: How many spikes radiate from the bloom, spread evenly around it

parameters.name: Spike length
parameters.description: How far a spike reaches from the middle before it tapers away (px)

parameters.name: Spike width
parameters.description: Thickness of a spike where it leaves the bloom (px)

parameters.name: Spike angle
parameters.description: Rotation of the whole set of spikes (degrees)

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Brightness of the flash. Set it to 0 to turn the pack off

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: How long the flash lasts before it is gone (seconds)

parameters.name: Left button
parameters.description: Flash colour for the left button

parameters.name: Right button
parameters.description: Flash colour for the right button

parameters.name: Middle button
parameters.description: Flash colour for the middle button
